desc: Parse N, S, T from stdin.
Validate mapping: for each char c in S, all positions must share the same T; else print -1.
Build functional graph: edge c -> f(c) for distinct c in S with f(c)!=c; count E.
Compute indegree; count P = nontrivial cycles where every node has indegree exactly 1.
Impossibility: if len(set(T))==26 and P>0 print -1; else print E+P.
Verify samples 1-4 (4, 0, -1, 4) and edge cases (incoming cycle abc->baa = 3, multiple pure cycles, all-26 impossibility).
Code finalized and passed all public sample tests.
